title: Bookkido v2 — Go Rebuild Plan
body:
## Stack
- Backend: Go (stdlib, net/http, wzorzec humanMCP)
- DB: SQLite lokalnie, Supabase (Postgres) na produkcji
- Frontend: Go templ + htmx + Alpine.js + Tailwind CSS
- Płatności: Autopay (BLIK, karta, przelew, recurring)
- Deploy: Fly.dev (single Go binary)

## Architektura
- Single Go binary: SSR HTML (templ) + REST API (JSON) + htmx partials
- Auth: JWT w httpOnly cookies (nie localStorage!)
- Rate limiting na login/register
- Kalendarz i payment flow: Preact/Svelte islands

## Fazy
- Faza 0: scaffold, auth, deploy
- Faza 1: homepage, listing, offer detail, merchant dashboard
- Faza 2: Autopay, rezerwacje, order flow, subskrypcje, faktury
- Faza 3: messaging, reviews, documents, CRM

## Core entities (MVP ~40 endpointów z 150+)
- User (Merchant + Customer)
- Offer, Package, Location, Category
- Reservation, Order, Payment
- Child (participant), Instructor
- MerchantSubscription, Invoice

## Źródło designu
- Pixel-perfect z istniejącego frontendu Next.js
- Tailwind klasy kopiowane 1:1 do templ
- Komponenty React → templ components
- Źródło: bookkido-frontend__prod__13_04/src/
